relations.evidence: jaya Bhūpatīndramalla devasana ñalāyā śrīśrīIndramalladevasake gaurīvivāha pyākhana huyakala vāṅāyā

notes: The colophon is a short administrative note/record (dharoṭa) regarding the staging/performance of the Gaurīvivāha play at Patan (Yala) before King Indramalla on behalf of King Jayabhūpatīndramalla of Bhaktapur. The date given in the catalogue metadata (NS 827 pauṣa śukla tṛtīyā śukravāra) is not present in the quoted colophon fragment.
